world.title: Foot-and-Mouth Outbreak Hits Botswana’s Beef Exports
world.description:
The government has said the ongoing battle against foot-and-mouth disease (FMD) is placing significant pressure on the national economy and local livelihoods. Agriculture Minister Edwin Dikoloti said the outbreak has severely impacted beef exports, leading to a loss of access to the European Union market.
"In Botswana, many households depend on cattle for income and food; therefore, any disruption affects entire communities," the minister said. He announced that the government is pivoting its strategy to work more closely with partners, including the private sector and faith-based organizations.
Earlier this year, the government reported outbreaks in the northeastern region near the Zimbabwe border and in the southern Ramatlabama area. The authorities have restricted livestock movement and implemented vaccination campaigns.
